desc:
"A red fruit?" Apple! Apple! Apple! Apple! Everyone matched! 🍎

Sit at a table, read the topic, and write the answer you think everyone else will write. If all answers are the same, the whole table wins coins!

🪑 Play with 4, 5, or 6 players
🤝 Work together, not against each other
🤖 No players? Play with bots anytime
🎁 Open crates for cool chairs and boards
😂 Throw funny items at your friends
💤 Take a nap in the AFK zone and earn coins

👍 Like the game and join the group for future updates!
